description: Repairs r-sort-3/create-corpus-mdb: the one-INSERT-per-row loads into the unique-indexed tables W (from T) and W2 (from U) used Database.Execute without options, so a refusal returned hr 0 and neither the refusal nor its error number was recorded. Asks, on a copy of fixture r-sort-3-corpus-mdb (MDB) opened read/write: new tables WR(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(255)) and W2R, each with a unique index UX_K on K, filled by one INSERT INTO ... SELECT ID, K FROM T (IDs 1 to 203) or FROM U (IDs 1 to 37) per statement with dbFailOnError, DBEngine.Errors read after each; then the IDs that survive in each and each table's index metadata.
